ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the potential for Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and Texas, and follow the money to determine who is involved and how much is at stake.
questions: Who is involved in the potential Medicaid fraud?
How much money is at stake?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money and investigating the potential for Medicaid fraud, we can shed light on a critical issue and bring about positive change.
